flashcard_questions.q: What is peacemaking in religious teaching?
flashcard_questions.a: Actively working to bring about peace and end conflict.

flashcard_questions.q: Which Gospel verse promises that peacemakers will be called children of God?
flashcard_questions.a: Matthew 5:9, from the Sermon on the Mount.

flashcard_questions.q: What did Jesus teach in Matthew 5:44 about enemies?
flashcard_questions.a: “Love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you.”

flashcard_questions.q: Which two countries did Pope Francis help to reconcile?
Why did Quakers refuse to fight in the World Wars?
flashcard_questions.a: They are committed pacifists who believe all war is wrong.

flashcard_questions.q: What does the Arabic word “Islam” mean?
What does Surah 4:128 teach Muslims about peace?
What does the Qur’an 8:61 require when an enemy offers peace?
flashcard_questions.a: Muslims must incline towards it and put their trust in God.

flashcard_questions.q: What is the greater jihad in Islam?
flashcard_questions.a: The inner spiritual struggle to be a good Muslim.

flashcard_questions.q: Which hadith teaches that greater jihad matters more than lesser jihad?
flashcard_questions.a: “We have finished lesser jihad, let us now focus on greater jihad.”

flashcard_questions.q: What is the ummah in Islam?
flashcard_questions.a: The worldwide community of Muslims, united by shared faith.

flashcard_questions.q: What does Matthew 25:40 teach about helping people in need?
flashcard_questions.a: Whatever is done for the least of these is done for Jesus himself.

flashcard_questions.q: Which Christian charity has helped victims of conflict in Syria and South Sudan?
What proportion of their savings must Muslims give as zakah?
What does Surah 5:32 say about saving one life?
flashcard_questions.a: “Whoever has saved a life, it is as though he has saved the whole of mankind.”

notes: 15 cards: 4 belief→source (Matthew 5:44, Surah 4:128, Qur’an 8:61, Matthew 25:40), 4 term→definition (peacemaking, Islam, greater jihad, ummah), 3 practice→meaning (zakah rate, Surah 5:32, Qur’an 8:61), 2 person/organisation, 1 hadith→attribution, 1 denomination position (Quakers). Dropped 'victims of war' as a glossary term that restates its own words.
